instructions.baseline: canonical-instructions-0.1; identical for all models; no oracle spans
instructions.challenger: challenger-impact-path-0.1; same scope, adds hypothesis ranking and impact-path discipline

execution: Same real SDK Agent/Runner path, same model per paired case, same max_turns/tool_budget/spend ceiling; only instructions differ (baseline vs challenger). One reliable backend for primary comparison (Luna); Gemma local for zero-cost pre-flight. Held-out not used for tuning.
success_gate: M9 pilot: ≥2 previously missed confirmed material findings across different PRs (≥1 nontrivial behavioral/cross-file), no unexplained loss of baseline's confirmed, higher useful-comment proportion without suppressing proposals, bounded calls/cost, revision-bound evidence with triggering condition. Two discoveries are development gate, not production reliability (long-term ≥80% useful).
